Name: DE-BillsItems
Statement:
select  bi.Oid as BillId,
        bi.Number as BillNumber,
        art.Name as Service,
        bi.Description as Description,
        ssu.Id as UserId,
        ssu.Name as [User],
        ssu.HasImage as UserHasImage,
        vat.Oid as VatId,
        vat.Name as Vat,
        vat.Percentage as VatPercentage,
        bi.UnitPrice as UnitPrice,
        bi.Discount as Discount,
        bi.Quantity as Quantity,
        bi.ValueWithoutVat,
        bi.VatValue,
        bi.ValueWithVat,
        eit.ValueWithoutVatIncome as EstimateItemValueWithoutVat,
        eit.VatValueIncome as EstimateItemVatValue,
        eit.ValueWithVatIncome as EstimateItemValueWithVat,
        eit.Discount as EstimateItemDiscount,
        eit.QuantityIncome as EstimateItemQuantity
from    BillItem bi
            left join Article art on bi.Article = art.Oid
            left join UserLookup ssu on bi.[User] = ssu.Id
            left join Vat vat on bi.Vat = vat.Oid
            left join EstimateItem eit on eit.Oid = bi.EstimateItem
